character.name: Abby
character.description: Source-faithful facial expression and performance reference library.

cues.label: Focused stare
cues.description: Brows drawn slightly inward with a firm, direct eyeline.

cues.label: Look screen right
cues.description: Held right-facing head turn with a searching off-camera eyeline.

cues.label: Look screen left
cues.description: Held left-facing head turn with several off-camera eye positions.

cues.label: Soft closed-mouth smile
cues.description: Small symmetrical smile moving through open and closed eyes.

cues.label: Broad toothy smile
cues.description: Open, symmetrical smile with visible teeth and lifted cheeks.

cues.label: Tense clenched grin
cues.description: Teeth held together with a compressed, uneasy cheek shape.

cues.label: Knowing smirk
cues.description: Asymmetric half-smile paired with a direct, slightly narrowed gaze.

cues.label: Eyes up and right
cues.description: Upward side eyeline with minimal head movement and changing mouth shapes.

cues.label: Eyeline circuit
cues.description: Eyes trace a deliberate up, side and downward circuit before returning to camera.

cues.label: Delighted side glance
cues.description: A bright smile travels from camera into side and upward eyelines.

cues.label: Light laugh
cues.description: A brief spontaneous laugh before the face resets for the sad take.

cues.label: Sad / worried
cues.description: Raised inner brows with a downturned mouth and softened direct gaze.

cues.label: Distraught
cues.description: Eyes squeeze shut as the face breaks into an open-mouth cry of distress.

cues.label: Laugh and move hair
cues.description: A separate bright laugh paired with a hand moving through the hair.

cues.label: Eye roll / annoyed
cues.description: Eyes roll upward and across while the mouth stays tight and unimpressed.

cues.label: Scared / fearful
cues.description: Brows lift and draw together as widened eyes search from side to side in fear.

cues.label: Surprise / shock
cues.description: Eyes widened and jaw dropped, moving through several side eyelines.

cues.label: Bright surprise
cues.description: Second surprise take with open eyes and a rounder, less tense mouth.

cues.label: Warm laugh
cues.description: Open laugh settling into a relaxed, sustained smile.

cues.label: Disgust / teeth bared
cues.description: Upper lip raised, nose tightened and teeth exposed before turning aside.

cues.label: Off-camera laugh
cues.description: Spontaneous laugh and smile directed to someone off camera.

cues.label: Pout / sulky
cues.description: Lower lip pushed forward with a lowered or sideward gaze.

cues.label: Proud / defiant chin
cues.description: Chin raised with a closed mouth and composed, resistant posture.

cues.label: Thoughtful eyes up
cues.description: Eyes and chin lifted into a slow upward and sideward search.

cues.label: Listening still
cues.description: Centered listening posture before the response begins.

cues.label: Confused side glance
cues.description: Head and eyes turn aside as Abby processes what she hears.

cues.label: Open-palmed question
cues.description: Both palms open into an incredulous, questioning gesture.

cues.label: Frustrated appeal
cues.description: Raised hands and lifted chin push the appeal to a stronger finish.

cues.label: Guarded, arms crossed
cues.description: Closed stance with folded arms and a suspicious side eyeline.

cues.label: Decisive walk
cues.description: Arms release as Abby turns and approaches the window.

cues.label: Window confrontation
cues.description: Close, wary inspection through the glass with a firm upward eyeline.

cues.label: Reading / checking notes
cues.description: Focused reading posture with the page held near chest height.

cues.label: Pinning clues
cues.description: Reaches up and attaches notes to the glass surface.

cues.label: Inspecting the board
cues.description: Steps back and scans the arrangement at eye level.

cues.label: Realization look-up
cues.description: Attention lifts away from the notes into a held upward realization.

cues.label: Approach the piano
cues.description: Walks into position and reaches toward the upright piano.

cues.label: Standing piano performance
cues.description: Standing keyboard action moving from body-wide to close hand reference.

cues.label: Step back and turn
cues.description: Breaks from the instrument and turns toward the room.

cues.label: Delighted laugh
cues.description: Open, delighted reaction held toward someone off camera.

cues.label: Piano hands — steady pattern
cues.description: Top-down hand and finger reference for the complete keyboard phrase; Abby's face is not visible.

cues.label: Walk-on profile
cues.description: Side-on entrance across the performance space into a front-facing mark.

cues.label: Neutral standing mark
cues.description: Front-facing neutral stance with small weight adjustments.

cues.label: Playful wave
cues.description: Light one-hand wave opening into a buoyant upper-body gesture.

cues.label: Spin and flourish
cues.description: Loose rotational step with arms opening away from the body.

cues.label: Hands-on-hips stance
cues.description: Confident, squared stance with hands set at the hips.

cues.label: Floor drop and recovery
cues.description: Drops into a low floor pose, rolls weight forward and begins to rise.

cues.label: Enter and sit
cues.description: Steps into the setup and lowers onto the practical support.

cues.label: Grounded seated pose
cues.description: Settles into a poised seated position before the lift.

cues.label: Float into lotus
cues.description: Transitions into a cross-legged levitation pose with open knees and relaxed hands.

cues.label: Levitation look-around
cues.description: Sustains the floating pose while looking upward and around the space.

cues.label: Dismount and exit
cues.description: Unfolds from the seated setup and walks out of frame.

cues.label: Spin initiation
cues.description: Starts a loose turn with one arm trailing behind the torso.

cues.label: Overhead turn
cues.description: Rotates under a raised arm with hair and torso following the arc.

cues.label: Reset and sway
cues.description: Returns to neutral, then shifts weight into a gentle side sway.

cues.label: Lean-back recoil
cues.description: Torso pulls backward in a loose, surprised recoil.

cues.label: Open-arm balance
cues.description: Arms extend at different heights as the body balances through a diagonal.

cues.label: Camera approach
cues.description: Steps toward the phone while keeping the movement loose and playful.

cues.label: Guarded floor pose
cues.description: Curled seated pose with arms wrapped close and gaze shifting downward.

cues.label: Rise with arm sweep
cues.description: Rises from the floor through a broad arm arc.

cues.label: Neutral reset
cues.description: Front-facing standing reset before the next phrase.

cues.label: Loose sway
cues.description: Soft side-to-side dance phrase with drifting hands.

cues.label: Startled hands to face
cues.description: Both hands rise sharply to frame the face in a startled reaction.

cues.label: Open-arm release
cues.description: Hands drop away from the face and open wide into the space.

cues.label: Conversational gestures
cues.description: Alternating hand shapes and small shrugs support a conversational delivery.

cues.label: Confused searching glance
cues.description: Eyes track off camera as the brows pinch and the mouth stays slightly open.

cues.label: Questioning squint
cues.description: Narrowed eyes and a tense upper lip turn the appeal into a pointed question.

cues.label: Wary frustrated side-eye
cues.description: A strong sideways eyeline sits under tightened brows during the final frustrated beat.

cues.label: Guarded downward gaze
cues.description: Eyes lower beneath a closed, resistant brow while the mouth remains firmly set.

cues.label: Window alarm
cues.description: Widened eyes and a dropped jaw register sudden contact at the window.

cues.label: Searching eyes up
cues.description: Eyes search upward while the face remains tense and the lips stay parted.

cues.label: Clue-board realization
cues.description: The head lifts and the eyes widen as the clue-board task resolves into a discovery.

cues.label: Delighted piano reaction
cues.description: An open-mouth smile appears on the turn away from the piano.

cues.label: Pleased upward smile
cues.description: A small satisfied smile follows an upward off-camera eyeline.

cues.label: Skeptical pucker
cues.description: The lips push into a compact pucker beneath a skeptical tilted gaze.

cues.label: Levitation eyes up
cues.description: The chin rises into a steady upward gaze during the lotus lift.

cues.label: Guarded side glance
cues.description: A compact sideways glance checks the space while the face stays guarded.

cues.label: Serene eyes-closed tilt
cues.description: Eyes close into a quiet, pleased head tilt during the first turn.

cues.label: Joyful eyes-closed grin
cues.description: A full closed-eye grin opens at the crest of the overhead turn.

cues.label: Lifted broad smile
cues.description: The eyes and chin lift under a broad, sustained toothy smile.

cues.label: Languid eyes-closed content
cues.description: Closed eyes and a soft asymmetrical smile settle into a languid tilt.

cues.label: Recoiling shock
cues.description: Eyes jump upward and the mouth rounds open during the camera recoil.

cues.label: Delighted look-up laugh
cues.description: The head tips back into an open laugh aimed above camera.

cues.label: Defiant chin lift
cues.description: A raised chin and tight closed mouth create a compact defiant pose.

cues.label: Hands-to-cheeks pout
cues.description: Both hands frame a compact pout beneath an upward eyeline.
